thread:
SRE-bot: Pager triggered — api-gateway edge: elevated 502/504 rate in us-west-2. Rolling 5m error rate 13% (threshold 1%).
Maya Chen: got it — oncall is me, switching to incident mode. Paging Theo and Priya now.
Theo Park: sitting up. looking at Grafana dashboard: spike started 12:07 UTC, request rate normal, latency p50 up ~40ms but p95 >> 1s
Priya Singh: seeing a lot of 504s, upstream timeouts to model-proxy-pool. Possibly saturation on the egress side.
Ivan Lopez: checking load balancer logs. A few backend hosts returning 502 with body "upstream reset". Also increased tcp retransmits.
Maya Chen: @OpsPager can you mute noisy alerts and keep pager channel to this thread? :loud_sound:
OpsPager: muted non-critical alerts for 60m. Incident severity set to Sev2.
Elena Ramos: quick check on deployments: no recent gateway deploys in last 3 hours.
Theo Park: running tcpdump on a suspect host: capturing syn/retry patterns. attaching snippet.
Theo Park: ```
21:12:34.567891 IP model-proxy-3 > model-backend-1: Flags [S], seq 0
21:12:34.567993 IP model-proxy-3 > model-backend-1: Flags [R], seq 0
``` 
Priya Singh: model-backend 1 is oom-killed earlier today, but marked unhealthy and removed — but we see some traffic hitting a stale ip in the L7 cache.
Maya Chen: can we flip to fallback routing to model-proxy-v2 cluster for edge traffic? If we can route non-critical requests to v2 we reduce pressure.
Ivan Lopez: adding temporary route rule now: set header X-Route: v2 for 20% of traffic. Command:
```bash
redwoodctl route update --target model-proxy-v2 --match "path:/gen/*" --percent 20
```
SRE-bot: Route update accepted, change id r-8f3a. Rolling out 20% -> 50% over 10m.
Priya Singh: after 10m, error rate for wins: dropped from 13% to 6%. p95 latency on gateway down 30%.
Maya Chen: good. let's scale up gateway pool by +4 instances in us-west-2 as short-term.
Theo Park: scaling group request sent. Estimated spin-up 2m.
Elena Ramos: customer impact: 32 active customers affected in last 15m, top impacted: acme-data, fastchat-inc. Notifying CS.
Maya Chen: @Priya can you check if any WAF rule or rate-limiter is erroneously tripping? Also watch backend queue length.
Priya Singh: WAF clear. Rate-limit logs show a small spike but below thresholds. Backend queue length on model-proxy-v1 was increasing — likely slow backend responses.
Ivan Lopez: investigating DNS TTLs — one of the LB records still cached an older IP for a retired host. Pushing cache flush to CDN edge.
OpsPager: CS update posted to #customer-impact: short note + list of affected customers. :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: after routing bump and scale, errors stable around 1.2% now. Recommend continued monitoring for 30m, schedule handoff at 30m with oncall follow.
Theo Park: capturing diagnostics for postmortem: nginx 502 responses, backend connection resets, kernel dmesg show occasional conntrack drops.
Elena Ramos: saving logs and snapshotting the Grafana panels. I've set retention tag incident/1712104321.
SRE-bot: Incident state changed: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Assigned: Maya Chen. Pager schedule updated.
Maya Chen: starting post-incident checklist. Notes:
- root cause hypothesis: stale DNS/healthcache leading to a small percentage of traffic hitting decommissioned backends; combined with slow backend responses -> queueing -> timeouts -> 502/504 fanout
- Immediate mitigations: route partial traffic to v2, scale gateway, flush CDN/LB cache
- Actions: ensure health cache invalidation on host retirement, add additional upstream retry/backoff, add synthetic canary after deployment to validate health
Priya Singh: will open ticket to add cache-flush hook in deployment pipeline.
Ivan Lopez: I'll audit conntrack/iptables settings and confirm safe limits.
Maya Chen: handing off to Theo for night monitoring. Please escalate if error rate >2% for 10m.
Theo Park: ack. I'll take the nightwatch and continue log aggregation.
OpsPager: Handoff complete. Pager clear for others. :cheers:
SRE-bot: thread closed. Summary: 502/504 spike in us-west-2 mitigated by routing & scaling. Postmortem ticket: INC-2026-1712104321 created.
